arguments.query: select b.booking_id,b.status,b.request_id,b.amount_cents,(select group_concat(charge_id||":"||idempotency_key) from charges c where c.booking_id=b.booking_id) ch from bookings b where status!="confirmed"
select event_id,json_extract(payload,"$.booking_id") pb,json_extract(payload,"$.schema_version") sv,booking_id,attempts,status from outbox where status!="delivered" and (pb!=booking_id or sv!=1)
select charge_id,booking_id,idempotency_key,amount_cents,state from charges where booking_id in (select booking_id from bookings where status="pending")
select status,count(*) n,max(attempts) a from outbox group by status
select event_id,json_extract(payload,"$.booking_id") pb,json_extract(payload,"$.schema_version") sv,attempts from outbox where status="pending" and (pb!=booking_id or sv!=1)
select event_id,booking_id,payload,attempts from outbox where status="pending" and (payload not like "%"||booking_id||"%" or payload not like "%schema_version\": 1,%")
select event_id,booking_id,payload,attempts from outbox where status = 'pending' and (payload not like '%' || booking_id || '%' or payload not like '%schema_version": 1%')
select o.payload, b.passenger_id, b.flight_id, b.status from outbox o join bookings b using(booking_id) where event_id like 'evt_00000387%'
select service,path,status,message,count(*) n from request_logs where status>=400 group by 1,2,3,4

select b.status, count(*) n, sum((select count(*) from charges c where c.booking_id=b.booking_id and c.state="captured")=1) one_chg, sum(exists(select 1 from holds h where h.booking_id=b.booking_id)) hold, sum(exists(select 1 from checkins k where k.booking_id=b.booking_id)) ck, sum(exists(select 1 from outbox o where o.booking_id=b.booking_id and o.status="delivered")) ev from bookings b group by 1
select * from customer_events order by rowid desc limit 12
